Per check with WebGPU on a laptop GPU. Two to six seconds on CPU only.

Fresh samples, set 2

Human text: Hacker News comments from 2014, Project Gutenberg novels, Wikipedia as of 2019. AI text: 16 passages written by Claude, most of them deliberately casual (short emails, a Slack message, Reddit advice). Real photos: Wikimedia Commons uploads from before 2019. AI images: Midjourney, DALL·E 3 and Flux. Scores are from the shipped, compressed models running in a browser.

What it misses

Very short, casual AI text: a 90-word email, Reddit advice and a Slack message still come back as human or unclear. Some encyclopaedic human writing (2019 Wikipedia paragraphs) still scores as possibly AI, and a few Hacker News comments land in Unclear. On images, most misses are DALL·E 3 pictures from one collection, and a few real photos land in Unclear.
